verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official first-party CLI, DataDog/datadog-ci, which by name targets CI use. Datadog also documents an API Reference for programmatic, non-UI access. However, the evidence is only titles and pointers, with no documented headless or CI workflows, commands, or authentication setup. Missing for 10: documented CLI commands and CI pipeline usage, headless auth/configuration details, a reachable OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404s), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
